message: Vector Rebel 3.2.87: Confirm today?s Captain roster, show pending native checks and view department-wide BC staffing with short C-shift history.
releaseNotes: Daily Captain Check ALWAYS opens current-tour crew confirmation before rendering any saved history. Prior-tour overtime is excluded unless added to today?s selected crew. Confirm Crew & View Check immediately projects saved real native Item Log results onto today?s roster and clearly distinguishes checked items, pending native verification and missing PPE mappings. Refresh Native Item Logs performs a new read-only audit on the confirmed crew. Today?s incomplete tour is not marked with failed red X based on an early or stale read. BC Check now opens a full department-wide daily staffing view from the latest trusted Rebel Scout direct ListView snapshot instead of showing Station 4 only. The source capture date and any staleness are explicit; the BC can review, correct and confirm today?s lineup locally without writing CrewSense or official inspections. BC presents a compact, Captain-style table, current PPE evidence, and last three C-shift tour results from native saved history or Rebel Command receipts. Unsupported/uncollected PPE always remains UNKNOWN. Background monitor stays collapsed under Master details. Backend department-roster read endpoint requires an owner-linked authenticated Vector Rebel and returns read-only data.
